blocks.text: National University's Sab Amora moved a step closer to claiming the inaugural UAAP women's singles badminton title, defeating Ateneo de Manila University's Jochelle Alvarez, 21–16, 21–11, in the Round of 16 on Friday at the Gameville Central Park in Mandaluyong City.
